Done. Implemented all three functions:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js: Uses Math.max/Math.min to constrain the value to [min, max].
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js: Divides by 1024 iteratively through B/KB/MB/GB units and formats with one decimal place.
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js: Lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, then strips non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes).

Updated CHANGELOG.md with the three additions.
